prompt:
In many countries a large number of newly qualified teachers leave the profession within their first few years of work.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: The essay should have two parts: problems first, then measures

Problems: classes constantly changing teachers and students losing continuity, growing pressure on experienced staff, training costs going to waste, staffing shortages widening in rural and small schools
Measures: guidance from an experienced teacher in the early years, reducing non-teaching paperwork, lowering class sizes, making pay and career progression clearer, extra support in difficult areas
The measures should be clearly matched to the problems
It should be shown that pay is not the only reason teachers leave (workload, lack of support, status)
common_mistakes: Turning the problems section into an essay about student behaviour
Offering only 'salaries should be raised' as a measure and producing no other measures
Writing about the education system of one specific country
